proposals.title: Proposal 5 – Shareholder Proxy Access Amendments
proposals.topic_summary: Amend proxy access bylaw to remove limit on shareholders aggregating shares into nominating groups and raise shareholder nominees to 25% of board or two, whichever is greater.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 5.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal on Human Rights Committee
proposals.topic_summary: Establish a Human Rights Committee to review, assess, disclose and recommend enhancements to Apple's human rights policy and practice, with public reporting.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 6.
